FOSSiBOT F2400 Portable Power Station | 2,400W 2,048Wh

  • Power up to 16 devices simultaneously with 2400W output, featuring 13 ports on the EU version and 16 ports on the US version.
  • 2048Wh Capacity | 2400W AC Pure Sine Wave Inverter (4800W Surge)
  • LiFePO4 Battery with 4,000+ Life Cycles to 80%
  • AC Recharge the portable power station from 0 to 100% in just 2 hours.
  • 4 ways to charge (AC/Solar/Car/AC+Solar);
  • Smart HD LCD display
  • LED Soft Lighting & SOS Signal
  • 10ms uninterruptible home backup UPS;
  • 5-Year full-device warranty for a worry-free experience.
  • Note: If you purchase a power station and solar panel combination product, the solar panels and power station will be shipped separately.

FAQ

  • Q1: How many solar panels can l use at the same time with F2400？
    A:

    It depends on the total voltage and watts of solar panels you choose. F2400 supports solar panels with maximum of 500W, 50V in voltage. So with 200W solar panels, 2 solar panels are recommended.

  • Q7: What kind of solar panels should l choose for F2400?
    A:

    PV input requirements for F2400:
    Work Voltage: 11.5-50V
    Input Power: 500W Max.
    Include MC4 connectors.
